title: Repair selected-runtime decommit access and validate SDK integration
goal: Reject decommitted ranges in checked guest access and enforce decommit host protection without changing release policy or silently replacing the verified SDK baseline.
acceptance: Audit page commitment and access-query callers, then make a minimal licensed source patch that rejects checked reads/writes of decommitted pages and makes forbidden raw accesses fault
Preserve neighboring pages, physical aliases, reservation/recommit behavior, budgets and explicit protect_on_release policy; add partial-page and boundary regressions
Compose an independently identified private SDK derivative on Windows/Linux, verify transitive sources/compiler/artifacts and retain failed baseline evidence
Integrate the validated derivative into preparation/cache identity; regenerate outputs after changed toolchain identity, never edit generated guest source
validation: The original memory harness must report all applicable cases passing on Windows/Linux native and supported sanitizers, with deliberate failing oracle and real page faults
Run relevant isolated SDK tests and regress neighboring commit/protect/release/alias operations; record unsupported instrumentation and aggregate limitations
Reproduce both owned guarded header/next-import checkpoints with the integrated derivative and full input/output hash checks before advancing title services
size: bounded repair and integration; split additional defects
